name: mirrai-careers
description: Resume, job search and career planning: match jobs, salaries, tailored resumes, cover letters.

interface.longDescription:
Mirrai Careers brings your whole job search into your AI assistant: your resume, matching jobs, the market for your role and a personal career plan. The assistant works with your real Mirrai data (profile, tailored resumes, cover letters, applications), so you never paste your CV into the chat again.

What you can do:
• Find jobs and see how well you match: search open jobs, read postings, get a match score with strengths and gaps, and add jobs to your application tracker.
• Check the market for a role: open jobs, new postings, remote share, top employers and salary ranges, with how many postings they are based on.
• Get a personal career plan: take the Mirrai career test together with your assistant and read your career strategy report.
• Tailor a resume to a job in about a minute and export the clean PDF employers receive.
• Edit your profile and resumes: rewrite bullets, update the summary, add a new job. Every change is saved like your own edit, with undo, and tools that change data are marked so the assistant asks first.
• Write a cover letter with Mirrai AI and rewrite it from your feedback.
• Upload an existing resume PDF and turn it into your profile; you approve before anything changes.

You stay in control: choose what the assistant may do (view, edit, run Mirrai AI), see a log of every action, and disconnect any time. Job postings are marked as third-party text. Mirrai does not apply to jobs on your behalf. Sign in with your Mirrai account.
defaultPrompt: Find jobs that match my Mirrai profile.
Tailor my resume to this job and export the PDF.
How much do product managers earn in the US?

positive.description: Account overview: read the user's profile and resumes
positive.prompt: Show my Mirrai profile and my resumes.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the test profile (Alex Morgan, Senior Product Manager, London) with 3 past roles and skills, plus the list of tailored resumes and applications in the account.

positive.prompt: Find senior product manager jobs in London on Mirrai and tell me how well I match the best one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open product manager jobs in London, then returns a match score for one job with strengths and gaps based on the profile.

positive.description: Tailor a resume to a job and export the PDF
positive.prompt: Tailor my resume to the best matching job from the search and export it as a PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new resume tailored to the job (takes 1-2 minutes, progress is reported), then returns a link to the exported PDF.

positive.description: Cover letter written by Mirrai AI, then revised
positive.prompt: Write a cover letter with Mirrai for my most recent tailored resume, then make it shorter.
positive.expected_behavior: Generates a cover letter saved in Mirrai (version 1), then a shorter version 2 of the same letter; both versions are kept.

positive.description: Salary and market snapshot for a role
positive.prompt: How much do product managers earn in the US?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the number of open jobs, new postings, remote share, top employers and a salary range (25th percentile, median, 75th percentile) with the number of postings it is based on.

negative.description: Off-topic request: Mirrai should not be called
negative.prompt: What's the weather in London today?

negative.description: Bulk export of the job database: should be declined; jobs are for personal search and daily limits apply
negative.prompt: Export every job listing in Mirrai to a spreadsheet.

negative.description: Automatic job application: Mirrai does not apply on the user's behalf; it can give the employer's apply link or add the job to the tracker
negative.prompt: Apply to the best matching job for me automatically.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, show plans or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: resume and profile editing, tailored resumes with PDF export, cover letters, job search with match scores, market and salary snapshot, career test and report.
